prior_reason_rebuttal: Prior verdict called it a duplicate entry. Read the homepage, the course-catalog page (/lp-profile/, same content as /courses/), /private-training/, /mentorship/, /about-us/, and /media/ — this is unambiguously a training-only business, not an academy-with-clinic. Every offering (Master Course video modules, private hands-on training, mentorship program) is sold to and consumed by aesthetic injectors/nurses to improve their own injection skills; none of it is a treatment a member of the public can book for themselves. The site's own BOOKING link even points off-domain to skinspirit.zenoti.com — founder Lindsay Breinholt's separate clinic (SkinSpirit SLC) — confirming this domain itself has no patient-facing clinic or 'model call'/student-clinic page at all, so this is a clean TRAINING_ONLY case, not the ambiguous academy-with-clinic scenario.
proposed_markdown_reason: Online + in-person training academy selling injectable courses, private hands-on training, and mentorship to nurse/provider injectors; no patient-bookable treatment is offered on this domain (its booking link points to a separate business, SkinSpirit SLC).
